source: Molotov's proposal of 23 Jul 1939 that military talks begin at once in Moscow; the British and French acceptance of 23 to 25 Jul 1939 (DBFP Third Series vol. VI); Chamberlain in the Commons, 31 Jul 1939; the missions (Drax, Doumenc) sailed from Tilbury on 5 Aug, reached Moscow on 11 Aug and opened the military talks on 12 Aug 1939 (DBFP Third Series vol. VII, appendix II)
note: The only delayed action. Realized tick 6 (23 to 25 Jul); the effect (talks military) is visible at tick 12 (10 to 12 Aug), the tick of the opening session of 12 Aug. The delay records the realized pace: the missions were constituted between 26 Jul and 2 Aug and travelled by sea; travel by air was raised in London and not taken (not verified). A shorter delay would be a counterfactual on the pace of the talks, not on their feasibility.
